aviation_incidents.headline: 紐幾內亞航空 Fokker 100 在瓦尼莫中止起飛 調查機關評估是否立案
aviation_incidents.summary: 《The Aviation Herald》報導，紐幾內亞航空一架 Fokker 100 於11月21日準備執飛瓦尼莫往韋瓦克的 PX141 航班。飛機在瓦尼莫機場12跑道加大推力準備起飛時，其中一具發動機伴隨連串異響、推力下降，回升後又再度下降。機組在極低速時中止起飛，飛機隨後返回停機坪。涉事飛機註冊號為 P2-ANH。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air Niugini Fokker 100 rejects takeoff at Vanimo; investigators assess the occurrence
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The Aviation Herald reported that an Air Niugini Fokker 100 was preparing to operate flight PX141 from Vanimo to Wewak on November 21. As the engines were accelerating for takeoff from Vanimo's runway 12, one engine rolled back with a series of chattering sounds, accelerated again and then rolled back a second time. The crew rejected the takeoff at very low speed and the aircraft returned to the apron. The aircraft was registered P2-ANH.

new_information: Alaska Airlines crew members were reportedly left too shaken to fly following ICE arrests on a Seattle jet bridge.
A pilot reportedly walked off and two flight attendants asked to be replaced after the arrests.

international_aviation.headline: 比利時全國示威衝擊航班：布魯塞爾與沙勒羅瓦機場11月23日多數航班取消
international_aviation.summary: 布魯塞爾機場（BRU）預計11月23日出現大規模航班中斷。比利時飛航服務商skeyes部分航管人員將加入全國示威，skeyes屆時無法提供正常飛航管制服務，機場表示多數進出港航班必須取消，中斷時間為當地時間7時至21時。
international_aviation.headline_en: Belgian strike to ground most flights at Brussels and Charleroi airports on November 23
international_aviation.summary_en: Brussels Airport (BRU) expects major flight disruption on November 23, after some air traffic controllers at Belgian air navigation service provider skeyes said they would join a national demonstration. The airport said most arriving and departing flights will have to be cancelled because skeyes will not be able to provide normal air traffic control services during the action, with disruption expected from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. local time (6 a.m. to 8 p.m. UTC).

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍申報以MH-47G直升機使用沖繩下地島機場加油，沖繩縣要求自制
international_aviation.summary: 《沖繩時報》等日本媒體報導，美國陸軍在日期為11月16日的文件中向沖繩縣申報，將於11月23日使用宮古島市的下地島機場，目的為加油。依《沖繩時報》報導，申報時段為日本時間下午4時30分至5時30分，使用的是兩架 MH-47G 直升機。琉球朝日放送報導，這兩架直升機據信隸屬日本境外的美軍基地。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Army files to refuel two MH-47G helicopters at Okinawa's Shimojishima Airport (SHI); prefecture asks it to refrain
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Army notified Okinawa Prefecture, in a filing dated November 16, that it would use Shimojishima Airport (SHI) in Miyakojima on November 23 for refuelling, the Okinawa Times and other Japanese media reported. According to the Okinawa Times, the filing covers 4:30 p.m. to 5:30 p.m. Japan time and two MH-47G helicopters. Ryukyu Asahi Broadcasting reported that the helicopters are believed to belong to a US base outside Japan.

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空見習副機師滑行中接電話據報遭解僱
international_aviation.summary: 據播客節目Black Box Aviation Podcast轉述，一名達美航空見習副機師在初始操作經驗（IOE）訓練期間執行首趟上線航班，飛機由亞特蘭大滑行準備起飛時，他的手機響起，他在機長滑行期間接聽了電話。機長隨即返回登機門，將該名副機師請下飛機，其後該名副機師遭到解僱。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta trainee pilot reportedly dismissed after answering phone while taxiing
international_aviation.summary_en: A Delta Air Lines first officer on new-hire training reportedly lost his job after answering his cellphone while the aircraft was taxiing for departure, according to an account shared on the Black Box Aviation Podcast. The captain is said to have returned to the gate rather than continue to the runway, and the first officer was removed from the aircraft and later dismissed. The podcast's social post places the incident in Atlanta and calls it the new hire's first trip on the line.
